chapter.verse: Vantungmi nihte Sodom-ah nitakin hong tung uh hi; Sodom khua kulh kongpi-ah Lot na tu hi. Lot in amaute a muh ciangin, amaute dawn dingin ding a, lei lakah a mai ngatin kunin,

“Ka tote aw, kong thum hi, na nasempa’ inn lamah hong kihei un la, hong giak un, na khete uh sil un; tua ciangin zingsangin tho baihin na pai nading lam uhah pai pan un,” ci hi. Amaute in, “Hi lo hi; khua sung tualpi-ah ka giak ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in amaute nakpi takin kun hi; tua ahihciangin amaute ama' lamah kihei a, ama' innah lut uh hi; amah in amaute adingin an bawl a, silngo sawh loh anlum em hi, amaute in ne uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute’ lup ma-in khua sung mi, Sodom khuamite, a moi a ham-in mi khempeuh in a inn umcih uh hi;
amaute in Lot sam a, “Tu nitak-a nang’ kianga hong tung mite koi-ah om ahi hiam? Amau’ taw ka luk theih nadingun ko kiangah amaute hong paikhiatpih in,” ci uh hi.
Kongkhak pualam-a mite' kiangah Lot pai-in kong lehkhak a,
“Ka sanggamte aw, tua banga na gitloh gamtat loh nading uh kong thum hi.

En un, ta nungak nih ka nei hi; no' kiangah amaute hong paikhiat pihsak un la, na ut bangun amaute' tungah bawl un; hih mite' tungah bangmah bawl kei bek un, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute keima' inn sung hong tung khin uh hi,” ci hi.

Ahih hangin amaute in, “Taikhia in!” ci uh hi. Amaute in, “Kote’ kiangah hong peem pak a, tu-in nang thukhen hong kineih! Tu-in amaute' sangin nang kong siatbawl zaw ding uh hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in nakpi takin Lot’ lam hong neh uh a, kongkhak a phukham zah dongin hong neh uh hi.
Ahih hangin mi nihte in amau’ khut hong zan-in inn sung amau' kiangah Lot paipih uh a, kong khak uh hi.
Inn kongkhak-a om mi a neu a liante amaute in a mit uh tawsak a, tua ahih ciangin kongkhak a zawt zawt hangun mu zo lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi nihte in Lot kiangah, “Hih lai-ah tanau dang na nei hiam? Makte, tapate, tanute, ahih kei leh khua sunga nang’ mi peuhpeuh hih mun panin paikhiatpih in;
bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite a kimawhsakna thu lianpi Topa ’ tungah tung khin a, a susia dingin Topa in kote hong sawl khin ahih ciangin hih mun a susia ta ding ka hi uh hi,” ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Lot paikhia-in a tanute a ten’pih ding a mak dingte' kiangah, “Tho un, hih mun panin paikhia un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in khuapi a susia ding hi ta hi,” ci hi. Ahih hangin amah a mak dingte tungah a ciamnui bang lel hi.
Zingsang khua vak ciangin vantungmite in, “Khuapi dan piakna sungah kangtum kha ding na hih uh ciangin tho in la, hih lai-a om na zi leh na tanute la in,” ci-in Lot sawl hamtang uh hi.

Ahih hangin amah lungka-in om lai veve hi; tua ahih ciangin, Topa in ama' tungah hehpihna nei ahih manin, mite in amah leh a zi leh a tanu nihte a khut uh tawh manin, amaute in amah paikhiatpih-in khua pua lamah koih uh hi.
Amaute in a paikhiatpih khit uh ciangin, “Na nuntak nadingin tai un; nunghei kei un la, kuam sungah zong khawl kei un; note hong kangtum kha ding ahih manin mual tungah tai to un,” ci uh hi.
Lot in amaute' tungah, “Hi lo hi, ka tote aw;

en un, note’ muhna-ah na nasempa in maipha mu zo a, ka nuntakna nong hutna uhah migitna lianpi kei' tungah nong lak khin uh hi; ahih hangin mualtung gamla ahih manin ka tun’ ma-in siatna in kei hong pha-in ka si ding hi.
En un, gal-a om khuapi tai nadingin nai a, a neu khuapi khat ahi hi. Tua lai-ah hong taisak un—a neu khat hilo ahi hiam?—tua hi leh ka suakta ding hi,” ci hi.
Amah in ama' kiangah, “En in, na gensa khuapi ka lumlet loh nading, hih ngetna zong nang kong pia hi.
Kinawh in la, tua lai-ah tai in; bang hang hiam cih leh tua lai-ah nang na tun’ mateng ke’n bangmah ka hih thei kei hi,” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua khuapi min Zoar kici hi.
Zoar-ah Lot a tun ciangin tua lai-ah ni suak khin ta hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in vantung panin Sodom leh Gomorrah tungah kaat leh meikuang zusak hi;
amah in tua khuapite, kuamte khempeuh, khuapite sunga mi tengte khempeuh leh leitunga a po khempeuh susia hi.
Ahih hangin a nunga om Lot’ zi nunghei a, amah cikhuam suak hi.
Topa mai-ah a dinnasa munah zingsang tungin Abraham va pai hi;
amah in Sodom leh Gomorrah leh kuamte khempeuh lam nga sukin khuadak hi, en in, leitang khu pen meiphualpi khu bangin kahto hi.
Pasian in kuam sunga khuapite a suksiat lai-in, Pasian in Abraham phawk a, amah in Lot’ ten’na khuapite a suksiat ciangin tua bang a suksiatna sung panin Lot sawlkhia a, tua bangin a piang ahi hi.
Tu-in Zoar panin Lot paikhia to-in a tanu nihte tawh mual tungah teng hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Zoar-ah a ten’ ding lau hi; tua ahih ciangin a tanu nihte tawh suanghawm sung khatah teng uh hi.
A u pen in a nau' tungah, “I pa teek a, leitung khempeuh ngeina bangin eite hong luppih ding pasal khat zong om lo hi.
Hong pai in, i pa leenggahzu khamsak ni, i pa tawh suan-le-khak i kizopsak theih nadingin amah tawh lum khawm ni,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in tua nitakin a pa uh leenggahzu khamsak uh hi; a u nu pai-in a pa tawh lum hi; a tanu a lup lam hita leh a thawh lam hita leh amah in thei lo hi.

A zing ciangin a u in a nau tungah, “En in, zan zan-in i pa tawh ka lum hi; tu nitakin zong amah leenggahzu khamsak ni; tua ciangin nang pai in la, i pa tawh suan-le-khak i kizopsak theih nadingin amah tawh lum khawm in,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in tua nitakin zong a pa uh leenggahzu khamsak uh hi; a nau pai-in amah tawh lum hi; a tanu a lup lam hita leh a thawh lam hita leh amah in thei lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lot’ tanute gel in a pa uh tawh ta nei uh hi.
A u in tapa khat nei-in ama min Moab phuak hi; amah in tu hun-a Moab mite’ pian’na pupi ahi hi.
A nau in zong tapa khat nei a, a min Ben-ammi phuak hi; amah in tu donga Ammon mite’ pian’na pupi ahi hi.
